data.name: Devanand
data.gender_notes: Devanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devanand is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deva’ (god) and ‘anand’ (grace or happiness). This name is bestowed upon a child to signify the presence and blessings of the gods in their life. The name evokes a sense of spiritual connection and divine grace. The name Devanand carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devanand usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine grace and blessings from the gods
data.etymology: Devanand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devanand total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
